page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Running head at top centre-left, page number at top right. Below the last line, a gathering mark "O" centred. No margin notes.

main_text.l: ante ætatem virilem , seséque tuetur Hie-
ronymi verbis nunc allatis , ex quibus
Homilias in S. Lucam ; sed profecto fallitur
Caracallæ qui regnare coepit anno Do-
dri severi annum ; hoc est ante annum
ex lib. 6. Hist. Eusebij cap. 24. ibi enim
ejusdem libri idem Eusebius memorat O-
Hæc omnia si conferas cum capitibus 3.

page.notes: The last word is hyphenated across the page break ("opi-"), continuing on the next page. The page is one unbroken paragraph running over from the previous page. The "O" at the foot is treated as a gathering signature. No marginal notes are printed; the marks at the right edge are scan noise and were left out.
